summary: Source reports increased movement of unmarked logistics convoys along the M-08 corridor near the Belarusian border. Three sightings within 72 hours, each between 02:00-04:00 local. Vehicles consistent with Ural-4320 chassis. No insignia observed.

Twitter accounts associated with the Tahrir-al-Sham media office have begun publishing in Turkish in addition to Arabic since March 1. Pattern suggests outreach to a new audience segment. Recommend adding @THS_TR_official to tracked-handle list.

Intercepted communications on 7.350 MHz between a station identifying as 'Oktyabrsky' and an unknown receiver. Use of the GLAVNYJ cipher pattern, last seen during 2022 exercises. Activity window 14:20-14:55 UTC, daily for past 6 days.

Multiple Telegram channels (n=14) coordinating a planned demonstration in Brussels for March 22. Estimated turnout 4,000-7,000. Channels are interlinked and amplify each other within minutes; suggests centralized coordination, possibly bot-assisted.

Source within the Bamako garrison reports the arrival of 6 individuals identifying as 'training advisors'. Equipment unloaded includes thermal optics and quadcopter ECM kits. No flag or unit insignia. Source assesses with moderate confidence: Wagner-affiliated.

Cryptocurrency wallet 0x4B2c...8aE9 received 47 BTC over 11 transactions in 36 hours, all from mixers. Wallet was previously flagged in connection with the August 2023 exchange compromise. Funds subsequently dispersed to 23 new wallets.
